about: Area pages group objects of every kind by game subsystem. A record's 'area' label is matched against 'labels' (case-insensitive); 'prefixes' route records by name first (checked before labels); 'overrides' pin single records ('kind:Name' -> slug).

areas.title: Ability data
areas.blurb: Ability NXD row accessor, JP cost, aux header and the ability action records.

areas.title: Application and startup
areas.blurb: Entry, frame loop, message pump, clock, exception handling and the startup debug/capture gates.

areas.title: Battle
areas.blurb: Battle logic outside the formulas: AI decisions and evaluation, action checks, ranges and targets, action resolution and execution, the turn engine (charge time, turn order, the timeline), the live unit table, status effects, the battle command menu and presentation, the ability and item lists, and the results and learning after a battle.

areas.title: Data access
areas.blurb: NXD table accessors, the table registry and other game-data lookups.

areas.title: Display
areas.blurb: Video/window state and resize handling.

areas.title: Errands
areas.blurb: The timed dispatch system: records, scoring, rewards, start and finish.

areas.title: Event commands
areas.blurb: The 4-byte command language: the handlers EventCmd_Run calls through its class table.

areas.title: Event system
areas.blurb: The event variable store, the cooperative task and thread scheduler, the event interpreter with its script loader and scanners, the dialogue, sprite, colour and camera tasks, and the helpers the event opcodes share.

areas.title: Battle formulas
areas.blurb: The battle formula functions, dispatched by formula id.

areas.title: Graphics
areas.blurb: The renderer: scene targets, glare/bloom, shader techniques and programs, sampler state, render contexts, the UI blur, layer effects and composite passes.

areas.title: Input
areas.blurb: Pointer polling and input state.

areas.title: Items and shops
areas.blurb: Item records and categories, and the shops.

areas.title: Job data
areas.blurb: Job table accessors, job records, skillsets, learning and job icon paths.

areas.title: Job list and unlock
areas.blurb: JobList_*, Job_*, Party_* and unlock/mask pages.

areas.title: Job tree
areas.blurb: The Job Tree screen: JobTree_* and JobRecord_* pages.

areas.title: Math
areas.blurb: Matrix and conversion helpers.

areas.title: Resource
areas.blurb: Pack entry lookup, file reading and inflation.

areas.title: Save data
areas.blurb: The schema layer for save and config records: the generic descriptor walker, the schemas for the save file and its sections, and the config file.

areas.title: UI framework
areas.blurb: GUI nodes, text/font rendering, widgets, input, hit testing and the UI render/command pipeline.

areas.title: Unit data
areas.blurb: Unit save, work and party records, stat and growth computation, egg hatching and scripted battle entries.

areas.title: Unit rendering
areas.blurb: Unit preview, sprite records, CharaRender/CharaSlot, palettes and renderer pages.
